what: Two Neatlogs conditional detections for Fence runs. Create each once in the dashboard (Detections > New > Conditional) or with the CLI commands below; Fence cannot create them itself.

detections.description: Fence stopped instead of changing code: the verdict was decision or no_record and a question was written for a maintainer.

unverified_alternative.note: Same condition read from span metadata instead of the span name. The metadata field path was not confirmed against the Neatlogs rule engine; check it in the dashboard's field picker before using it.

detections.description: The worker's change was rejected by Fence's own verification: a regression, a test that does not reproduce the issue, or a modified pre-existing test (existing_test_modified).

unverified_alternative.note: Narrower variant for modified tests only; metadata field path not confirmed.

cli: neatlogs detections create --group <group-uuid-for-Neutral> --type conditional --name 'Fence asked a human' --description 'Fence stopped instead of changing code: the verdict was decision or no_record and a question was written for a maintainer.' --threshold 0.5 --run-on '{"frequency": "span_type", "span_types": ["TOOL", "CHAIN"], "span_names": ["fence.ask"]}' --config '{"conditions": null, "logic": null, "root": {"type": "group", "logic": "AND", "children": [{"type": "rule", "field": "status", "operator": "=", "value": "OK"}]}}'

neatlogs detections create --group <group-uuid-for-Negative> --type conditional --name 'Fence fix failed verification' --description 'The worker'"'"'s change was rejected by Fence'"'"'s own verification: a regression, a test that does not reproduce the issue, or a modified pre-existing test (existing_test_modified).' --threshold 0.5 --run-on '{"frequency": "span_type", "span_types": ["TOOL"], "span_names": ["fence.verify"]}' --config '{"conditions": null, "logic": null, "root": {"type": "group", "logic": "AND", "children": [{"type": "rule", "field": "status", "operator": "=", "value": "ERROR"}]}}'
